notes.title: 🚀 Patch 5.0🔥
notes.content:
[h1][b]🔥THE EASY MODE HAS ARRIVED!🔥[/b][/h1]  
Have you always wanted a more accessible experience without giving up the fun? Now you can! The Easy Mode is here to let you face the game without the fear of being crushed at the first mistake!  

🔹 What changes with Easy Mode?  

⚡ [b]Enhanced Power-ups![/b] They last twice as long, so you can make the most of them!  
🔫 [b]Rapid Fire![/b] Forget long reload times: now you can shoot faster!  
🦵 [b]No more fall damage![/b] Jump without fear, landing is no longer a problem!  
👁 [b]The Runner chills out![/b] Forget relentless chases: now the Runner behaves like other NPCs.  

🔥 [b]CHECKPOINTS INTRODUCED![/b] 🛑  
No more infinite retries! In Easy Mode, you can now activate checkpoints! Look for the dispenser with the **T** and get close to save your progress!  

🔄 [b]LEVEL ADJUSTMENTS![/b] 🌍  
Levels have been rebalanced to seamlessly integrate checkpoints! Get ready for a smoother and less frustrating experience!  

🎤 [b]Farenz now TALKS![/b] 🗣  
Press the up arrow and hear what he has to say! What legendary wisdom will he share with you?  

🔧 Minor improvements and various fixes!  
Get ready to experience the game with a more polished and engaging feel!  

🔥 [u][b]Update now and try all the new features![/b][/u] 🔥

notes.title: Patch 4.0
notes.content:
🏃‍♂️ The Runner is on the Loose: A foe that chases you like your worst nightmare! Get ready to run!
💥 Super Star Health Bar: Enemies now shine with an improved health bar! They’ll be easier to track... and to defeat!
🎮 Fried Joypad Controls:
[list]
[*] The D-PAD enters the game! Use your finger like a ninja to move, in addition to the left analog stick!
[*] Right trigger activated! Launch insults at enemies with style and speed!
[/list]
🕹️ Top-Notch Joypad in the Menu: Navigate the menus like a pro, with zero hiccups!
🚫 Bye Bye Bug: Fixed the mysterious bug that hindered connection to the Steam Overlay! Now you can play and chat without issues!
